title: Assistance for Stallholders at Coffee Shops Faced with Increasing Rentals and Business Overheads
what_it_is: Assistance for Stallholders at Coffee Shops Faced with Increasing Rentals and Business Overheads

sections.label: HDB rental coffee shop rents
sections.summary: HDB kept rents stable, did not raise rent for 97% of rental coffee shops at renewal, and offers a 5% one-year discount for budget meals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB is committed to ensuring that the rents payable by operators of HDB rental coffee shops remain stable.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Over the last five years, HDB did not increase the rent for 97% of HDB rental coffee shops at renewal.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The increase in the median rent of HDB rental coffee shops was limited to 1.6% during this period.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Further, to help all HDB rental coffee shop operators transition to providing budget meals by 2026, HDB offers a rental discount of 5% for a period of one year, subject to verification that the new budget meals and drinks have been implemented.

sections.label: Government and cooked food prices
sections.summary: Government does not directly provide cooked food or set prices, and safeguards against runaway prices by ensuring wide availability of F&B premises.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Although Government is not in the business of directly providing cooked food or stipulating cooked food prices, ultimately, the best safeguard against runaway cooked-food prices is by ensuring wide availability.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: This, we do through ensuring that, in towns and across the island, there is a good spread of food and beverages (F&B) premises.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: This covers not just coffee shops in HDB estates, but other kinds of F&B outlets and also hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: In terms of the strategy that Assoc Prof Jamus Lim has described, I think that is something that the Government would consider very carefully and it is not a step that we would take lightly.
